chunks: From him, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Ḥammād, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd, from one of his mawālī, who said:
Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام said to me: “The diyah of the child born of zinā is the diyah of a Jew: eight hundred dirhams.”

key_terms.الْيَهُودِيِّ: a Jew; here, a legal comparison category for diyah
key_terms.دِرْهَمٍ: dirhams, a unit of silver currency
key_terms.دِيَةُ: financial compensation due in cases of unlawful killing or injury

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah for a child born of zinā according to this hadith from Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling concerning the diyah assigned in the case of a child born of zinā. It classifies the compensation amount as equivalent to that of a Jew, specifying it as eight hundred dirhams.
